# Page Scraping Analyzer

The Apify actor [`apify/page-analyzer`](https://apify.com/apify/page-analyzer) as typed Telo kinds, generated from its build **0.0.11**. The module's version is that build number, and every run it starts is pinned to exactly that build, so the input types below are the ones the actor really runs with.

Performs analysis of a webpage to figure out the best way how to scrape its data. Provide a URL and data points to find and get back a detailed dashboard showing how the data can be scraped. Works with initial and rendered HTML, JavaScript variables and dynamically loaded data.

## Pricing

Free — you pay only for the Apify platform usage (compute units) of the run.

Runs are charged to the Apify account whose token the `ApifyClient` holds. See the [Store page](https://apify.com/apify/page-analyzer) for current prices.

## Import

```yaml
imports:
  Actor: oci://ghcr.io/telorun/apify/apify-page-analyzer@0.0.11#sha256-…
```

Pin the digest with `telo upgrade`. The module re-exports `ApifyClient`, so it is the only import needed.

## Usage

```yaml
kind: Actor.ApifyClient
metadata: { name: apify }
token: !cel "secrets.apifyToken"
---
kind: Actor.Run          # or Actor.Start for runs longer than 5 minutes
metadata: { name: scrape }
client: !ref apify
maxTotalChargeUsd: 1     # optional: timeout, memory, maxItems, maxTotalChargeUsd
---
kind: Run.Sequence
metadata: { name: main }
steps:
  - name: scrape
    invoke: !ref scrape
    inputs:
      url: "http://books.toscrape.com/catalogue/a-light-in-the-attic_1000/index.html"
```

- **`Run`** calls Apify's synchronous endpoint and returns `{ items }`. Apify holds the request open for at most 300 seconds; a longer run fails with HTTP 408.
- **`Start`** starts the run, long-polls it until it finishes, and returns `{ run, items }`. A run that ends `FAILED`, `TIMED-OUT` or `ABORTED` raises `APIFY_RUN_NOT_SUCCEEDED` with the run as `data`.

## Input

Only these fields are accepted — `telo check` rejects any other.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `url` | string | yes | `"http://books.toscrape.com/catalogue/a-light-in-the-attic_10` | Page URL — URL of a website to by analyzed. Use a page URL that you would want to scrape. You can run this actor again for different page type (e.g. one run for search results page, another run for product detail page). |
| `keywords` | array | yes | `["A Light in the Attic","51.77","In stock","22 available","a` | Keywords — Keywords to be searched for during analysis |
| `proxyConfig` | object |  | `{"useApifyProxy":true}` | Proxy configuration — You should use proxies for scraping. Use datacenter proxies but fallback to residential ones if blocked too much. |

## Output

The actor publishes no dataset schema, so `items` are untyped objects.
